final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ma.department AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) AS c FROM income i JOIN member m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.dept AS dept, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.dept AS dept, s3.c AS c, s3.r AS r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
